# Disagreement Log — GTH_111

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 111
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 111 | "in your presence" | "before you" | "right before your eyes" | *empetōfe*: presence vs. before vs. eyes |
| 2 | 111 | "will not see death" | "will not taste death" | "will not face death" | Death idiom: see vs. taste vs. face |
| 3 | 111 | "Does not Jesus say" | "Does not Jesus say" | "Hasn't Jesus said" | Meta-citation form: present vs. perfect |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "in your presence" (presence as witness), "will not see death" (see-death idiom from Saying 1 and John 8:51, maintaining intra-Thomas consistency), and "Does not Jesus say" (present tense, as the saying is currently standing).
